caption: Scenario A follows a developing Mayurbhanj cloud from observed conditions into its forecast.
Cyan shows prepared observations while purple carries the forecast forward in time.
This mixed-phase growth cell has an estimated first-flash window of 18 to 27 minutes.
The forecast separates motion, growth, and new initiation instead of blurring the next frame.
At the −10 °C level, the ZDR column marks the mixed-phase signal needed for electrification.
With radar unavailable, the forecast is less certain because mixed-phase growth is no longer observed.
The warning composer fills every prepared forecast field into English, Hindi, Odia, SMS, phone, and CAP previews.
Issuing the exercise warning records the selected cell, forecast time, and horizon on the shared timeline.
At +25 minutes, the observed first flash falls inside the predicted window.
